sql: SELECT pt.property_type_name, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN t.tenure_code = 'L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM transactions t JOIN properties p ON t.property_id = p.property_id JOIN property_types pt ON p.property_type_code = pt.property_type_code WHERE t.ppd_category_code = 'A' GROUP BY pt.property_type_name ORDER BY pt.property_type_name

SELECT d.district_name, AVG(t.price), AVG(t.price) - (SELECT AVG(price) FROM transactions WHERE date_of_transfer BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31') FROM transactions t JOIN properties p ON t.property_id = p.property_id JOIN districts d ON p.district_id = d.district_id WHERE t.date_of_transfer BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31' GROUP BY d.district_name ORDER BY d.district_name
SELECT MAX(price) FROM transactions WHERE date_of_transfer = '2026-07-20'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE tenure_code = 'L' AND ppd_category_code = 'B'
SELECT MIN(price) FROM transactions WHERE new_build_code = 'Y' AND record_status_code = 'A'

SELECT c.county_name, COUNT(*) FROM transactions t JOIN properties p ON t.property_id = p.property_id JOIN districts d ON p.district_id = d.district_id JOIN counties c ON d.county_id = c.county_id WHERE t.ppd_category_code = 'A' AND t.date_of_transfer BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31' GROUP BY c.county_name ORDER BY c.county_name

SELECT pt.property_type_name, AVG(t.price) FROM transactions t JOIN properties p ON t.property_id = p.property_id JOIN property_types pt ON p.property_type_code = pt.property_type_code WHERE p.town_city = 'LONDON' AND t.date_of_transfer = '2026-07-17' GROUP BY pt.property_type_name ORDER BY pt.property_type_name

SELECT tt.tenure_name, SUM(t.price) FROM transactions t JOIN properties p ON t.property_id = p.property_id JOIN tenure_types tt ON t.tenure_code = tt.tenure_code WHERE p.district_id = 167 AND t.new_build_code = 'N' GROUP BY tt.tenure_name ORDER BY tt.tenure_name

SELECT c.county_name, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN t.new_build_code = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS pct FROM transactions t JOIN properties p ON t.property_id = p.property_id JOIN districts d ON p.district_id = d.district_id JOIN counties c ON d.county_id = c.county_id WHERE t.date_of_transfer BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31' GROUP BY c.county_name ORDER BY pct DESC, c.county_name

SELECT property_type_name, transaction_id, price FROM (SELECT pt.property_type_name, t.transaction_id, t.price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.property_type_name ORDER BY t.price DESC, t.transaction_id ASC) AS rn FROM transactions t JOIN properties p ON t.property_id = p.property_id JOIN property_types pt ON p.property_type_code = pt.property_type_code WHERE t.date_of_transfer BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31') WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY property_type_name

SELECT county_name, district_name, avg_price FROM (SELECT c.county_name, d.district_name, AVG(t.price) AS avg_price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.county_name ORDER BY AVG(t.price) DESC, d.district_name ASC) AS rn FROM transactions t JOIN properties p ON t.property_id = p.property_id JOIN districts d ON p.district_id = d.district_id JOIN counties c ON d.county_id = c.county_id WHERE t.date_of_transfer BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31' GROUP BY c.county_name, d.district_name) WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY county_name
SELECT street, town_city FROM properties WHERE property_id = 1
SELECT property_count FROM postcode_areas WHERE outward_code = 'AL1'
SELECT new_build_code, tenure_code FROM transactions WHERE transaction_id = '5834E4E8-588D-29C7-E063-4804A8C015BC'
